renders.query: select band,step,series,status,items,units,published_at,render_count from textbook_volume_renders order by series,step

type_level.query: select type,v_level,count(*) rows,count(distinct ref_id) sources,count(*) filter(where coalesce(length(answer_key->>'explanation_ko'),0)>0) explained from csat_dcp_items group by type,v_level order by type,v_level

dictionary.query: select list_tag,count(*) words from shared_dictionary cross join lateral unnest(list_tags) list_tag where list_tag in ('kcurr2022_1','kcurr2022_2','kcurr2022_0') group by list_tag order by list_tag

source_strata.query: select d.type,d.v_level,count(*) rows,count(*) filter(where a.status in ('ready','published')) ready_or_published_source,count(*) filter(where e.article_id is null) cache_missing,count(*) filter(where e.source_updated_at=a.updated_at) cache_fresh,count(*) filter(where e.article_id is not null and e.source_updated_at<>a.updated_at) cache_stale from csat_dcp_items d left join library_articles a on d.kind='article' and a.id=d.ref_id left join csat_source_eligibility e on e.article_id=d.ref_id where d.type in ('vocab_choice','unit_vocab','blank_word','grammar_choice','grammar_fix','unit_grammar','word_order','rhyme','word_meaning','spell_blank') group by d.type,d.v_level order by d.type,d.v_level

function_definitions.query: select proname,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) definition from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname in ('textbook_shelf_inventory','textbook_practice_items_for','textbook_shelf_sources')

rows.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.textbook_shelf_inventory()
 RETURNS TABLE(item_type text, v_level integer, item_count bigint, explained_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT item_type, v_level, item_count, explained_count
    FROM public.textbook_shelf_inventory_mv;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.textbook_shelf_sources()
 RETURNS TABLE(v_level integer, source_family text, item_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT v_level, source_family, item_count
    FROM public.textbook_shelf_sources_mv;
$function$

legacy_function.query: select proname,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) definition from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='textbook_practice_items'

rows.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.textbook_practice_items(p_v_level smallint, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, type text, paragraph_idx integer, payload jsonb, ref_title text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT i.id, i.type, i.paragraph_idx, i.payload, a.title
  FROM csat_dcp_items i
  JOIN library_articles a ON a.id = i.ref_id
  WHERE i.kind = 'article'
    AND i.type IN ('order','insert',
                   'topic','blank','main_point','title','summary',
                   'purpose','implication','content_match','claim','mood',
                   'long_order','long_reference','long_match',
                   'long_title','long_vocab')
    AND i.v_level = p_v_level
    AND a.status IN ('ready','published')
    AND a.display_only = false
    AND public.csat_source_is_eligible(a.id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM csat_item_attempts t
      WHERE t.dcp_item_id = i.id AND t.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  ORDER BY i.id
  LIMIT greatest(1, least(p_limit, 50));
$function$

gaps: Stored DCP count is measured zero because three elementary types are generated deterministically from dictionary
Legacy RPC requires article and reading types; elementary generation needs a separate runner path
Render count is not current assigned stock or verified grading

limits: Inventory counts measure availability by type and V-level, not actual assigned/current book item IDs
Source counts can overlap across types; do not sum sources as distinct population
Published render status is an operational publication record, not rights or educational qualification
Null approved stock means unmeasured, not zero
Dictionary count is generation material, not item quantity or learning evidence
